top_choice_rationale: The optical lattice clock is a concrete, experimentally demonstrated invention: the magic wavelength cancels the light shift so many neutral atoms are interrogated at once, and stability and systematic uncertainty improve together to the 1e-18 level. It is reproduced in independent laboratories, has opened a field (gravitational redshift at millimetre scale, constants drift, dark-matter searches), and the two-name Katori and Ye allocation is clean and shared by five members. P002 is a mature, well-verified achievement but is further from my measurement-centred criteria; a prize is still better than no award.
